patch_description: Add a final exact maximin polish using an epigraph variable and all 165 triangle-area constraints. The existing evolutionary and gradient stages are useful for locating a promising orientation cell, but their lower-tail surrogate and discrete proposals do not accurately equalize the true bottleneck triangles. Within a fixed determinant-sign cell, maximizing the epigraph variable is a smooth constrained optimization problem. Recomputing signs between a few phases permits controlled movement if the initial local search lies close to a sign-cell boundary. This is the same active-constraint balancing mechanism that is especially effective for the 11-point Heilbronn problem.
